justification: Wires 615 frontend Jest tests into pre-push hook and fixes 71 stale test assertions. Changes span 17 test files + 4 config/doc files. No production logic changed — all changes are test infrastructure, mocks, and assertion updates to match current UI.

pre_impl.existing_data: 42 Jest test suites (615 tests) existed but were not enforced — drifted as UI evolved
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Test assertions referenced old button text, pricing ($49 not $29), removed fields, old API validation order
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new production code. All changes fix test expectations to match current production behavior.

functions.name: pre-push hook (jest step)
functions.input: git push event triggers hook execution in shell
functions.output: Blocks push if any of 615 Jest tests fail

values.if_missing: Tests fail with ReferenceError on Web API globals

break_it.scenario: Pre-push hook runs Jest on a machine without node_modules installed
break_it.what_happens: npx jest --bail fails, push blocked with clear error message
break_it.how: Hook runs from frontend-nextjs/ dir where package.json lives; CI/local both have deps
break_it.repro: git push from fresh clone without npm install

break_it.scenario: Jest custom env breaks on Node < 20 (no native fetch/Response)
break_it.what_happens: jest.polyfills.js provides fallback imports from undici
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/jest.polyfills.js imports from undici (bundled with Node 18+)

break_it.scenario: New component changes button text without updating test
break_it.what_happens: Jest fails on push, developer sees which assertion needs updating
break_it.how: Pre-push hook now enforces Jest — previously silent drift
break_it.repro: Change paywall button text and try to push
